email_subject: Application - Digital Content, Search & Engagement Specialist
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Content, Search & Engagement Specialist position at Septentrio. With my background in SEO, GEO, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to your digital marketing efforts and help keep Septentrio in Pole Position.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. I have hands-on experience with SEO principles, AI search optimization (GEO/AEO), and analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to implement structured data and improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines content, SEO, and audience engagement—areas I am passionate about. I am eager to learn and grow within an international high-tech environment, and I am comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your needs. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Digital Content, Search & Engagement Specialist position at Septentrio. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your digital marketing presence and help ensure your content reaches the right audiences at the right time.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation. I write keyword-targeted blog content and build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and Astra. I regularly track performance using SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console, using these insights to guide SEO and content decisions. This experience has honed my ability to translate technical topics into clear, engaging content for diverse audiences.

My passion for AI-driven search optimization is demonstrated through my personal project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I have also conducted iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's search-health score. This aligns directly with your focus on AI search visibility and GEO.

I am particularly drawn to Septentrio's mission and the opportunity to work in an international high-tech environment. I am eager to collaborate with cross-functional teams, support persona-based marketing, and contribute to the Brand Hub and social media activities. I am organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities. I am also fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch, with ongoing classes to improve.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
